title: Statistical 3-Sigma Rule Anomaly Detection
description: Parametric standard deviation thresholding for identifying extreme deviations from the mean in Gaussian data.
conditions: Feature distribution verified as approximately Gaussian (Shapiro-Wilk p > 0.05, |skewness| < 0.5)
recommended_methods: Modified Z-score using median and MAD for resilience against masking
selection_rules: If data is strictly Gaussian, standard 3-sigma Z-score is fast, interpretable, and sufficient
If data contains multiple outliers that inflate the standard deviation (masking effect), use Boris Iglewicz Modified Z-score with MAD
Never apply standard 3-sigma to heavily skewed, multimodal, or bounded count data
limitations: Fails catastrophically on skewed distributions (flags valid right-tail values while missing left-tail anomalies)
Single extreme outlier inflates mean and SD, hiding subsequent outliers (swamping/masking effect)
